## Testing

CI runs the `lint`, `test` and `secrets` jobs on this PR; all three must pass before it merges, and `scripts/merge-pr.sh` waits for them.

## Risk

This PR only moves dependency pins, with no code change. Its tier follows the paths it touches in `.review-gate.yml`: a PR under `.github/` or `scripts/` is high tier and waits for the code owner's approval.

## How to revert

Revert this PR (`git revert` its merge commit) to restore the previous pins.
